integrity: Analytical proof of all-size theorem; exact independent subset enumeration through eight partners and rational parameter checks through fifty partners; source comparisons do not constitute independent originality certification.
scientific_limitations: Uniform selection of exactly q surviving primary partner species; one-step fixed-bipartite coextinction model; pairwise covariance only; no inference for heterogeneous mortality, rewiring, higher-order cascades, or estimated ecological abundance.
title: One-switch dependence of paired species persistence under fixed-quota partner loss
